nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution

avis.texte: Lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin looking brighter and more even. With consistent use, I've noticed my dark spots becoming less noticeable. Definitely a great addition to my skincare routine!
This serum works great for my combination skin. It has really evened out my skin tone and is not drying. It also doesn't break me out. It's part of my regular routine now
It works, just have to be consistent with it, day and night. Id say its very expensive for the tiny bottle! But i do see rhe difference, i dont have my dark spots anymore!
It worked for me. I took a before and after picture after using it for 30 days and saw notable results. I mostly used it twice a day, but sometimes I only used it once.

Great smell and feel on skin, however after using the whole bottle I saw no difference in my spots. I have melasma and I know it's difficult to treat, but I was willing to spend the money to try this. I wouldn't recommend this for melasma, not sure about other sun damage.

I'm not sponsored to say this, but the serum really works if you use it consistently. You can't expect major results in just a week, yet I always end up returning to it. My only complaint is that it's pretty expensive.
At first I didnt notice a change but eventually the spots on the forehead started getting brighter
I love the dark spot solution so far. Been using it for about 2 weeks now. The texture is smooth and lightweight.
This serum works amazing for acne marks and scars! I'm usually skeptical with products that say your dark spots or scars will clear but this one actually did work!

I kept seeing this product all over tiktok and was hesitant to purchase mainly due to the price, but I've been using it for little under a week and my dark spots have faded drastically, I didn't expect to see a difference this early! Worth the money!

avis.titre: Works well but the trick is..
avis.texte: Apply within few minutes of washing your face. This is the first product i use. Then a moisturizing serum. If you stay consistent and take my advice, i promise your skin will glow like no other. Dark marks will fade
Did not notice ANY difference .! Dark spots still there and as dark as ever after using full bottle. Rip off.

avis.titre: Works if you keep using it.
avis.texte: I used this on my temple to help lighten an age/sun spot. It did seem to work after a couple weeks of use. I stopped using it and it seems ro have darkened again.
This serum caused me to breakout like crazy. I couldn't use it long enough to know whether it actually helps with hyperpigmentation and uneven skin tone, or not.
I've been using this for a couple of weeks and I notice difference in my darks spots, I'm gonna continuing using it to see better results :)
This stuff really does work. I usually don't notice a difference with items like these but this really brightened my skin and evened out my complexion. Definitely recommend

I am 40 years old with sun damage and freckles that I have always been self conscious of. I have used many dark spot treatments. I like this spot corrector and noticing difference. I think I will need more time to see but it works well with my face lotion. I only use at night.

This product has completely upgraded my skin care routine! Being a woman of color I experience a lot of skin discoloration. This product has been key in evening out my skin tone & improving my overall skin health. Love the nozzle it makes for easy application! 10/10!!!

this product is used as a serum before I apply my face moisturizer. I noticed a positive difference with my face. I have a bit of hyperpigmentation on my face and after using the Clearly Corrective dark Spot Serum for 3 weeks, I noticed my dark spots brightening significantly.

I liked using this serum for dark spots. It has some great ingredients, like salicylic acid and white birch. It's a nice brightening serum that doesn't irritate skin. I'm pretty sure it lightened up some acne scars, but not dark spots.

avis.titre: A new staple in my routine !
avis.texte: After using the product for a few weeks I have noticed a dark spot on my forehead has gotten lighter. I am so happy with the results so far and I cannot wait to continue using this in other parts on my skin . I was amazed at how effective this product is.

First I love that this is hydrating and not sticky for how thick of a serum this is. Second I honestly believe this stuff is working!! However, it is something you have to stick with and trust the process. It won't happen over night. I have several sun spots and this has lightened them dramatically. I work outside for part of the day and use SPF and even with SPF would get dark spots. This serum is so helpful with stopping that from happening.

I have been using this corrective dark spot serum for about a month now. My skincare routine includes cleanser, serum, and moisturizer(day time has SPF). I am just now starting to see some results. I use it just for spot treatments. With some patience I am seeing results but if I had to put this on my whole face it could get pricey. The bottle feels high quality along with the dropper. The serum it self doesn't have much smell to me. I love how it goes on and I love that it doesn't leave any weird feeling on my skin. Overall, I'm pretty happy with this product.
This product is great. I saw a difference within a week. I will be ordering some more.

I received the Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Correcting Serum in exchange for my honest review. After using it for a few weeks and I am very satisfied with the results so far. It has a light fragrance to it, and it is easy to apply, it absorbs quickly and won't leave my skin sticky or oily. I have noticed that my dark spots are less noticeable and my skin looks brighter. Absolutely recommend this serum.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product
avis.texte: It leaves my skin super soft but that's where the help stops. I've been using this product for over a month now and there is no difference in my dark spots. For that much money I expect better. I'll stick to my face peels.
I been using this product for a few weeks and my acne scars have definitely improved!
I have used this product for a few weeks and have definitely noticed a difference. My dark spots and uneven skin tone have definitely faded.

avis.titre: I can tell a difference in dark spots.
avis.texte: I have really dry and splotchy skin, and often have issues with products absorbing. I appreciate that this serum absorbs well, and isn't sticky. I apply before moisturizer to avoid the product pilling. It feels great on my skin. I've been using the product for a few weeks now and my spotting has definitely lightened. It has also helped my skin feel much more moisturized.
After using the Stark spot remover for two weeks, my face has really cleared up. I feel like it's more toned. I have added it to my every day routine and every night.

I really love how effective this product was at fading my dark spots. It blended easily into the skin and absorbed without leaving my skin feeling greasy. I also found this serum to be hydrating and helped to provide a more youthful appearance on my skin.
this is a holy grail in my skin care routine. This has helped with my dark marks. I love how it doesn't clog my pore and leaves my skin looking glowy. I love this product!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again so far!
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin and most products makes my skin irritated, including a majority of sensitive skin products. This product so far has worked great! No irritation side effects. I have notices a difference in my skin tone .

I was skeptical at first with this product since it was one of those feee samples but during my used of it slightly notice my dark spots fading slowly dont assume within a week they will fade very fast this procedure takes time and taking care of your skin I would recommend it to people to used it and give it time for better results

I have to use the serum every day for the last 2 weeks to see the result, I would like to say that the serum help a bit to make my dark spot go away. Especially the ones on my cheek and I feel like the skin texture is improve a bit. My skin is smoother and look more healthy.

I used this in hopes of reducing the dark spots on my face but saw minimal, if any, improvement in my spots. The serum has a great texture and no smell but it just really didn't deliver the results I was hoping for. I'll continue to use it until empty but doubt I'd purchase again. The price is too high to justify the minimal results.
I'm noticing some clarity in my skin from using this. And, with all Kiels's face products that I have tried, general skin texture is improved as well.

avis.titre: Another great product from a great brand
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I like that this product is mild on my skin. My skin can be sensitive to some active ingredients, but this didn't burn my skin. It is a light serum and not tacky. I did notice subtle lightening of some sun exposure near my eyes and some past acne scars on my forehead with use over the past few weeks.

I used this product for approximately three weeks before noticing a fading of a significant dark spot I have above my eyebrow. I think with longer use I'll see more benefit. The product is easy to use, blends well and definitely helps with removing dark spots.

Thin liquid. This feels ultra nice going onto skin. It seems to be helping clear blemishes a well as brightening my skin. After 2 weeks I have faith that this product will work wonderfully all the time. My appearance has improved since starting to use this and I'm so grateful to have this in my arsenal.

This stuff is great! I noticed a reduction in the dark spots on my chin from acne flareups in about two weeks of using the serum. I have very dry, sensitive skin and I did not experience any sensitivity with this. The texture is very light and not sticky at all. It absorbs almost instantly! I really love this product and would likely re-order

Have used this product over the la couple of weeks, I had a hormonal breakout recently so it was a good time to try it. Serum ir very lightweight and watery, been spreading it all over my face and see a little difference mostly on my little redness. I'll keep using it until bottle is finished to see final results.

I've been using Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution for a few weeks, and I've seen noticeable improvements in my skin tone. The serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly, making it easy to layer under other products. It works gradually, but with consistent use, I've seen my dark spots and hyperpigmentation fade significantly. One of the standout features is that it doesn't irritate my skin, even though it contains powerful ingredients like vitamin C. My complexion looks brighter and more even. Overall, Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution is a solid product if you are looking to reduce dark spots and brighten your skin.

I received the Kiehl's Since 1851 Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Correcting Serum in exchange for a review. I liked the product - brightened my skin and not drying. I will continue to use this product and see how the results are long term.

I've spent a lot more time out in the sun this summer for my job, and it tends to cause some dark spots to appear. I can happily report significantly fewer spots on my face compared to previous summers since starting with this product (even with more time in the sun)! I would recommend this product if needed for dark spot correction.
This made my face feel smooth and did help lighten my dark spots a little. I would need to use longer to see a more noticeable difference.
I used this product all Summer and noticed a huge difference in my skin. This is a game changer and will be in my routine going forward.

avis.titre: A new staple in my routine
avis.texte: I was really impressed with how quickly this worked in the dark spots under my chin. I've already recommended it to a few family and friends
After a few weeks I noticed reduction in the size and color of the dark spots on my face. Overall left skin brighter and more radiant. I can't wait to see how much more they fade!

This serum is amazing ! Texture is great not sticky or greasy. This did minimize the dark spots I do have on my face. I feel it lightened the spots, not completely gone but definitely made a difference that I can see .

I've been using this product for a few weeks now but I haven't seen a huge difference in my dark spots. It is not overly drying and it does not make my oily skin oily, it is a good balance. No smell and has not made me break out either

I used this product as directed and saw maybe minimal improvement, if any, in my dark spots. The serum has a great texture and no weird smell, but it just really didn't deliver the results I was hoping for. I'll continue to use as a serum, in case it just takes longer to work, but I doubt I'd purchase again.

As I get older, I've been looking for ways to combat some of the damage I did to my face from my teenage years in the tanning bed and sun. Most corrective products smell or feel weird on the skin but this serum dries down very quickly and isn't sticky on my skin. I have absolutely noticed a difference on my skin after about 4 weeks of use. I use it at night before my moisturizer and it's been a great addition to my skin care routine.
This product was great, I enjoyed the smell, it felt really nice and luxurious on my skin and I've noticed my skin has evened out

I had the result on my dark sport after using this product for almost 2 weeks. I integrated it in my daily beauty routine. I think using this serum is a great way to treat dark spots. I used other products before but this one is the best. I definitely buy new after finishing this bottle and recommend to my family members and friends.
It went on well, dried well and wasn't sticky. The problem is that it made no difference in my sun spots under my eyes and on my cheeks after over a month of using it. Was disappointed for sure.

avis.titre: Finally a potent vitamin c for dry skin!
avis.texte: Finally, a strong vitamin c that doesn't irritate my dry skin. My husband and I have both been using this product consistently for 2 to 2.5 weeks once every other day (daytime application). Although this isn't much time I like to give an honest review after a month. Application: very smooth Application, its not sticky or tacky and I can say I CAN apply it underneath makeup which is a huge plus for me..within this short time of using the product he noticed his dark spots slightly fading along with same small acne spots that faded. Also, he is extremely sensitive to strong scents and cant stand anything with a strong scent this product doesnt bother him at all he said he could do without the scent all together but it didn't bother him all that much.I noticed a difference in the texture of my skin, my acne scaring faded very slightly but I noticed , and I'm not sure how but somehow this product was slightly moisturizing for my DRY skin which is VERYYYY surprising because most ingredients in this product would dry me out.. especially salicylic acid and vitamin c. I am very happy with my results so far, and I am definitely looking forward to continuing to use it. (I did receive this product from Bzz Agent, but please understand I would never mislead anyone I always give my honest opinion).

avis.titre: Used for 3 weeks and saw no change in dark spot
avis.texte: I like the consistency of this product and the fact that it has little to no scent. The dropper is also a good way to desperate exactly how much product you want. I have had one dark spot on my cheek for months now so I thought this product would be good to lighten it. I used the product at least every other night for 3 weeks and saw no change. The lighter photo is actually the before photo and that is only because of the lighting in the room. I will continue to use the serum to see if there is any change long term but as of now I would not recommend it.

avis.titre: Not bad, but not for oily skin
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for about 2-3 weeks now so I could get a real feel for it. Honestly, I haven't noticed much of a difference in my skin. I have some acne scars and discoloration in my face and I haven't seen any of that fade. I have noticed a few new little white heads in places I don't normally get them, so I think this formula may be causing those. I have quite oily skin so anything clogging or heavy will cause a reaction. I let it sit for about 5-10 minutes before applying moisturizer and the serum is still sticky/tacky on my skin. So I don't feel It really sinks in very well to my skin type. The smell is pretty strong, but not harsh. Smells like lavender, very natural. My eyes and nose are very sensitive to strong smells and this serum did not affect me negatively. Overall, I would not repurchase personally for my skin type.

I really loved the packaging of this bottle. its so sleep and sophisticated looking. The dropper is really great quality and doesnt leak any product out like other droppers i have used. The product goes on your skin very smoothly and drices nicely without feeling greasy, sticky or pilly.

Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Correcting Serum effectively lightens dark spots, showing noticeable improvement within a few weeks, though they may not completely disappear. This serum is lighter and more effective than others I've tried, absorbing quickly and delivering visible results faster. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to brighten and even out their skin tone.

I started using this product more than a month to treat some stubborn dark spots and it has work wonder. I've seen some spots that are fading away. So thankful to Kiehl's and BzzAgent for gifting me this product to review it for free, now I have a bigger bottle as a backup.
I am super fair with some redness and a couple of dark spots. Everything has improved and my skin has luminosity now. Very happy with it. I will definitely purchase more.

avis.titre: Great addition to my daily routine.
avis.texte: After using this product for a few weeks now, I'm happy to say that I can see a difference in my sun spot of my cheek. It's very hydrating and leaves my skin plumped. It's not sticky and does not have a smell.

avis.titre: Good for dark spots without flaking
avis.texte: I am super fair-skinned so anytime I have a pimple or a hair or almost anything, a dark spot is left. I have tried other salicylic acid creams but they always make the spot very dry and flaky. I put this serum on before bed on a spot on my chin for 3 nights and it worked without the flakiness. It seems more hydrating than other products for this problem which is great.

I received the Kiehl's Since 1851 Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Correcting Serum in exchange for an honest review. I have dry skin, and I appreciate that this serum doesn't dry it out or leave a sticky residue. It absorbs well, but I recommend letting it sit for a bit before applying moisturizer and sunscreen in the morning to avoid any pilling. The product comes in a clear bottle, so be sure to store it away from direct sunlight. While I haven't used it long enough to see a noticeable difference in my acne spots, it feels great on my skin so far.
This product is great for getting rid of my dark spots. It makes my skin feel more hydrated and goes on smooth.

avis.titre: A must have in my routine!
avis.texte: First, I absolutely love how this serum soaks in and leaves my skin soft and supple. I have been using it for a few weeks now and it has absolutely made a difference in my sun spots. They were super dark and it has lightened them a lot! Will be continuing with this Serum! Hopefully after a few more months use they will be completely gone!

I received this product free from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I like this corrective dark spot serum, i use it for few weeks now. I tried several treatment to fade my dark spot, but so far this product gave a good improvement. my dark spot lighten around 50%. It is also moisture my skin, not making my skin dry. I will keep continue using this serum for few month to see better result.

I have been using this for about 2 weeks now. I do like how it applies to my face. Not sticky or oily gives my face a nice moisturized look. But I don't really see any change to the dark spots I have on my face. So I'll have to use a little longer and see if there are any changes
I have used this product daily for 2 weeks and have not seen any result

Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Serum is an exceptional product that has gained popularity for its effectiveness in addressing hyperpigmentation and dark spots. This serum features a blend of powerful ingredients, including vitamin C, white birch extract, and peony extract, which work together to brighten the skin and improve its overall tone. Many users have reported noticeable results within a few weeks of consistent use, with a more even skin tone and a reduction in the appearance of dark spots. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly into the skin, making it easy to incorporate into any skincare routine. Additionally, it is suitable for all skin types, which adds to its appeal. Overall, if you're looking for a reliable solution to tackle dark spots and achieve a brighter complexion, Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Serum is definitely worth trying. Its combination of effective ingredients and positive user feedback makes it a standout choice in the realm of skincare.

I have been using this product for over 2 weeks now and I notice a stark difference in my skin. I have gotten multiple compliments on how my skin is glowing and I look amazing. I love the way my skin feels with this on.

I enjoyed trying this serum out on some of my darker areas on my face. I felt like, after using for about a month, that it did in fact help with lightening of certain areas. I used this product as recommended and felt that it also added a bit of hydration to my routine.

avis.titre: Love how it feels on my skin!
avis.texte: I have been using Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution for about 2 weeks. I love how it feels when putting it on my face. It's smooth, not sticky, and makes my face feel hydrated. I am almost 50yrs old with sun damaged skin/age spots and while they didn't disappear they've definitely lightened. I've also noticed that the overall tone of my skin looks brighter and healthier. Using a few drops when applying the solution goes a long way so this bottle will also last a long time. I will be continuing to use this solution and highly recommend it.

avis.titre: Kiehls Dark Spot Serum Highly Recommended
avis.texte: Dark spot serum that actually works. Keep using regularly and it will show results.

I really enjoyed the Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Serum and will continue to use it. It feels really light but moisturizing on the skin and absorbs quickly so you can move onto the next step in your routine without waiting forever. This serum is gentle enough for me to use alongside my tretinoin without causing any irritation and likely helped reduce dryness from it. As I have a few actives in my routine to reduce dark spots, I know vitamin C is a winner and that Kiehl's takes vitamin C seriously! I love this additional step in my skincare routine. It's so easy to add and is nice to know the active ingredients are fighting my spots in a gentle enough way to use with other actives.

It's light and absorbs easily. I expected it to dry out my skin, but it does the opposite. My skin feels soft and looks moisturized after use. There is a mild fresh scent- not perfumy or overwhelming. I have only been using for a week, but my dark spots are already starting to lighten. I'm excited to keep using and see more improvement!

I use this product for four weeks, I do have discoloration on my skin, and I noticed a little bit of a difference on my skin. Feel like you have to use this product more than a couple of months to notice a real difference. But it will definitely be a staple in my skincare routine. I do want to say they should have more options because this product is a little too expensive for the standard consumer.

[received free product for honest review] been really loving this product for about a week now! I've always loved Kiehl's brand but had never tried a dark spot correction since I'm only 31, but I wish I had started it sooner. My sensitive skin has been loving this with no problems and I swear already looks more even with the lighter sun spots I do have on my cheeks! I really love the way it applies on my face and dries down so quick and nicely with only very very minimal "stickiness" to it. Once I add my moisturizer after a few minutes I truly don't even feel it on my face and head to bed. The amount you get in the bottle is great and a little goes a long way, since I only use it at night this will last me a few months for sure. Can't wait to keep using this and see what results I have in even just another couple weeks ☺️

avis.titre: I would definitely give it a try
avis.texte: Having tried several face serums in the past, including different vitamin C formulations, I can say that Clearly Corrective stands out as one of the best. Many serums I've used either felt too heavy or didn't absorb well, but this one has a lightweight texture that sinks into the skin almost instantly, doesn't really have a smell. I would give this a try if you are trying to get rid of spots. Also be consistent and give it some time. I was gifted this item in exchange for review.

I've been using this product for a few weeks now. I love the texture, not too thin or thick. It goes on well under sunscreen, primer, and didn't change the look of my makeup. I have pretty substantial darkening on my face and I am hopeful this will help. I can see a smoother finish already. What I like most is it hasn't made my skin peel. #FreeForReview

I was given this item in exchange for a review. I liked the smell of this serum, I haven't necessarily seen any changes in my skin yet and I've work it for 2 weeks. I imagine I have to do it for longer and then judge it then. the texture was nice, it was very moisturizing.

After using this product 1-2 times a day for about 3 weeks, I don't see a dramatic difference in my dark marks. The serum has a nice light texture that performs well under makeup and other skincare so I will continue to use in case I see a difference with more time.

I love Kiehls products, so I was excited to try their dark spot serum. After using it for 3 weeks, on a dark spot under my eye as well as on my hands, I have to say, I don't notice a discernible improvement yet. However, most serums require prolonged use to see true benefits, so I am optimistic based on how effective their other products are.

I love that this product goes on nice and smooth and doesn't leave a sticky residue. I wish that it was magic and I'd get results right away but with any this type a product consistent use is key. I can tell slightly that this product has lightened up a blemish on my face and I will continue to use night and day until I get results are to my liking. It doesn't take much time to add this regiment to my skin care routine so that's also a major plus. I like that the product it clear unlike the tented one I have used in the past. I recieved this product for free with the understanding that I give an honest review.
This corrector by far has been one of a few that has actually removed my dark spots in 2 weeks, I have a clearer and even complexion. Truly worth the try! :)

I tried this serum 2 time a day. After 1 week I feel my skin smooth and brighter. My skin too much oil but This serum have smell good, thin, no sticky, dry fast after I applied. I will buy it in future. Recommend it!

I love, love some of Kiehl's products including the Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution. It's quick drying and after almost 2 month of use I would say I've seen some improvement in my acne scarring. Now as with most products, I'd love instant results but know that regular use over long periods of time are more likely to show results than just a few weeks.

Pros: No strong smell. Not sticky like a product of this consistency can be. Absorbs quickly. Most importantly: It really works! I have several dark spots on my face and chest. After using this product as instructed for 2 weeks, some of my dark spots are almost completely gone and others have faded enough that they're not noticeable. Cons: None! There's not one bad thing I can say about this product.

avis.titre: Skin is smoother and clearer than before
avis.texte: I'm loving this product and will be purchasing again. My skin is sensitive but it has never been a problem with this. I would recommend for African American skin.

I have been using this product consistently for about 3 weeks. I love the way it makes my skin feels. However, at this point I'm not able to say that I've noticed a change with my dark spots. I will continue to use the product for the recommended length of time and update my review it the results change. I will say that you can tell it is a very high quality product. It feels very luxurious as it should considering the price.

avis.titre: Perhaps this works if I give it more time
avis.texte: In sampling this serum I was sure to keep everything else in my skincare routine constant. Now, I have only been experimenting with Kiehl's for two weeks. In that time I REALLY broke out all over the area I was using it on. I have been using it on my cheeks where I was prone to breakout in my teens and 20s, and had dark spots. It has been like I'm back in my adolescence all over again. I know that it takes a while to see improvements and for my skin to adapt to changes, so I am going to give it a full month (to go through an entire hormone cycle). The serum is not too drying, but it definitely is not oily like most serums I have tried (for various treatments). The smell reminds me of Gin alcohol, so that's kind of weird. Overall I think it might work for others, and I still hope it will work for me to bring an even complexion
I use the product daily. It goes on smooth and is not greasy or sticky. I have been using about 4 weeks and have seen some dark spots start fading.

Game Changer!!!I've used so many dark correcting serums in the past as i battled malesma and they take months for me to even notice a difference but with this product st saw results in 1 week. I was not expecting that. My malesma is much lighter now and i dont need to cover it up with make up anymore ! It's been 2 weeks so far and it is now added to my holy grail collection!
Started using it on some darker parts of my skin that has darkened and it's starting to lighten! Also used it on a couple scars and they're also fading a little bit after a couple uses.

avis.titre: Nice serum, not a quick fix
avis.texte: I have used this serum for a few weeks but have not seen a noticeable improvement on my dark spots. I've used it about 2-3 times per week to ease it into my routine. It did not cause irritation and dries down fairly quickly. I'll continue to use and be consistent, hopefully this will help reduce the appearance.

I received Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Serum in exchange for an honest review. The serum has a light consistency, it absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a sticky residue or feeling heavy. Although it has a strong scent, it fades quickly. Consistency is crucial. I believe the longer I incorporate it into my skin care routine, the better the results. I've noticed that a dark spot on my forehead, which has a been a major concern for me, has slowly started to fade. I believe continued use will help fade it even more effectively.
Enjoying the use of this products. Been using it for a while and I can see the benefits. Of course using it more long term will result in more results

avis.titre: Okay formula but not for me
avis.texte: The pros: pretty and easy to use packaging, no scent, and not sticky. The cons: after using this for three days only at night I got breakouts and my chin and cheeks. I know it was from this because this is abnormal for me and this was the only new product. Unfortunately I won't be continuing to is the product to find out if it reduces dark spots.

avis.titre: Great serum but don't expect instant results
avis.texte: I have been using the serum for a couple of weeks and I am really enjoying it! I feel like a lot of people here are expecting an instant transformation and you won't get that with ANY topical skincare product — consistency is key and it takes time! That being said, it is a cosmetically elegant serum that has a lightweight texture and absorbs quickly into the skin. Since it is a pleasure to use, and layers well with my other products, it makes it easy to be consistent. I'm enjoying the serum and will continue to use it. Can't wait to see what my long term results will be

I received this product in exchange of my honest opinion, I had high hopes for this product because I really want to get rid of my sun spots and acne scars. But, this didn't really help much with that, however it actually helped with my skin texture a lot.

avis.titre: I am happy with the results of this serum!
avis.texte: ~ Greetings, I have tried this corrective serum twice for two weeks as suggested; once during morning's skin routine and once during evening's skin routine. What I subsequently noticed specifically each morning upon rising that my skin looked more rested, brighter and refreshed. I also noticed that my sun spots are somewhat lighter in appearance, however, I would like to mention that not substantially lighter, but, more lighter than they were prior usage of this serum. This serum also soaks into epidermis of skin quickly and with ease. It also has a pleasant scent of soft lavender. My overall results with this serum was successful and I will continue using this product.

I love that this serum is specifically for dark spots as that's a problem area for my skin. I was impressed with the lighter formula that absorbs very quickly so you can continue with your other products. Kiehl's is an incredible brand that makes high quality skincare with the best ingredients, this product is no exception. I have used it for a short time but I see a slight difference in my sun damaged areas and I will continue to use it. I recommend this to anyone looking for dark spots reduction - this didn't irritate my skin either and has no fragrance which I love!
I have been using this for a week now and there is a little clearing on my dark spots from acne. It is not sticky or has an oily residue. I will continue using this product and recommend to friends.

In general, I have enjoyed my use of this solution. I haven't been using it for too long, so my major dark spots have not really faded. Some of my more minor acne scars have looked a bit better, but also not gone. A little goes a long way, and I appreciate that this serum doesn't run all over my face upon application. It dries pretty quickly and is not sticky or tacky. I will continue to use this product, but I don't honestly see myself purchasing it due to cost.

avis.titre: Good product, my skin likes it!
avis.texte: I like that it is not sticky like a serum, but it is thick enough that I can spread it in my face evenly. I like that my face is looking clearer, and no allergic reactions, I like this product.

I've been using Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Serum for a few weeks now, and while it has some strong points, I'm not entirely blown away. The serum has a pleasant, lightweight texture that absorbs quickly and feels refreshing on the skin. It's also gentle enough for daily use, which is a plus. I have noticed some improvement in my skin's overall radiance and tone, but when it comes to fading very dark spots, the results haven't been as dramatic as I hoped. It seems to work better for more subtle discolorations rather than stubborn, deep spots.

avis.titre: I fell in love with this product
avis.texte: I've been using the product for about two weeks and can already notice a difference in my hyperpigmentation. I can imagine the change that would happen with prolonged use. The serum doesn't leave a sticky feeling on the skin which I love. When using this product, do not forget to use your SPF!

After nearly 3 weeks of using Clearly Corrective Park Spot Serum, the light spots on my face have gradually faded. The product is easy to use with other moisturizers. When applied to the face, it absorbs quickly without causing unpleasant stickiness. The product has a pleasant light scent. The design is beautiful, attractive, and the essence pump is easy to use. I will continue to try it for a while longer.

I've been using Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution, and I'm really pleased with the results so far. The serum has a nice, lightweight texture that absorbs quickly, so it doesn't feel heavy on my skin at all. One of the things I appreciate is that it's gentle enough for daily use, even on my sensitive skin. After using it consistently, I've noticed that my complexion looks a bit brighter, and some of the dark spots I was concerned about seem to be fading. It took a few weeks to see real changes, but I think it's worth sticking with. Overall, it's been a good addition to my routine for tackling hyperpigmentation and evening out my skin tone.

After using this product for a few applications, I can say that I am pleasantly happy. My skin is smooth and supple. I cannot speak to the dark spot reduction quite yet, but I am waking up fresher and brighter so headed in the right direction!

Received this as an incentive from BzzAgent and Kiehl's. I have used with my moisturizer in the morning for the last two weeks. In the summer, I have noticed my sun spots lightening quicker than usual. I have not seen a difference in the scars on my face, but have only been using the product for a short period of time. I have very sensitive skin and this product absorbed well, did not pill, and did not irritate my skin. Will continue to use this product.

avis.titre: Enjoyed having this in my routine
avis.texte: I like this product! I feel like I need a little more time to truly see if it makes a difference, but I do feel it improved my dark spots a little. I enjoyed the scent and the formula, and felt it was an easy addition to my routine.

avis.titre: I love this product a new staple.
avis.texte: After using this product over the past few weeks , I noticed my dark spots faded slowly over time . So far I am loving the result . A little goes a long way . My skin feels glowy and hydrated.

I used this product as part of my am and pm routine. I saw minimal reduction in dark spots on the check and jawline. It might work better for those who have less pronounced dark spots or hyperpigmentation. I like the consistency of the product; it absorbs quickly and isn't sticky. One significant turn off for me was the scent; it was very strong for my taste. If you didn't like heavily fragranced skincare products, this isn't the product for
This serum is amazing. I have been using it for a week, and I can see the difference in my skin.

Product is easy to use in daily routines Am/Pm. Have been using for a few weeks but have not seen much of a difference in color. Product is light weight and is not sticky. Can be used under lotions .. makeup etc. No odor

I've been using this for about 3 weeks now, I don't notice a change to this one big dark spot on my cheek but I assume you have to use it longer to see noticeable results. Overall, the serum texture is comfortable on my skin. It also didnt irritate my sensitive skin which is usually a problem with strong serums. I would continue using this as my skin has no problem with it, hopefully it lightens my spot!

I received this product free in exchange for my unbiased review. I've only used this for a couple of weeks so far, but believe that I'll see more results with long term use. That being said, the packaging is nice. The product comes in a glass bottle with a dropper to dispense the product. It has a very subtle scent. I would recommend that persons with sensitive skin do a spot test before using in a full dosage as it did cause some skin irritation for me. Love the Kiehl's brand and would purchase
I am enjoying the lasting glow this product provides. I have been using for a few weeks now. I also like the scent since it isn't too strong. I have high hopes for what it will do for my dark spots.

avis.titre: Great item for your nightly routine.
avis.texte: After using this product for over a week I have noticed a slight difference in my dark spots. I will continue to use this product to ensure it continues to work. I loved the smell of this products and the feel of it against my skin. I recommend this product to try to help with your discoloration and dark spots. I would purchase this item again.

This serum is very lightweight and doesn't feel greasy. I layer well under makeup (doesn't make your foundation peel) I have unfortunately haven't used it long enough to notice any improvement of dark spots.

I have only used Kiehl's Dermatologist Solutions Clearly Dark Spot Solution for a couple of weeks and I see a little improvement. I have very sensitive skin and this solution is very gentle on my skin. I will definitely continue using this product and recommend it to my friends.

avis.titre: Would integrate in my daily skin care routine.
avis.texte: I received something in exchange for this post (free product, payment, sweeps entry). Overall I would give this product a 3.9. It is not bad but it also did not cause any significant changes to my skin. The bottle has a lot of product and may feel a bit tacky when you first apply it but it dries nicely without leaving any residue. Smells great and does help with evening your skin tone. I did notice my face looking and feeling a bit more smooth.
